sections.content: Why pickles? Because bland snacks are an insult to cravings. We handcraft real khatta gherkins with whole Indian spices, zero preservatives, and maximum misbehaviour.
Fresh gherkins, rock salt, whole cumin, mustard seeds, authentic tamarind pulp, sliced lemons
